info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Refunds-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve a list of refund requests for airline flights. It serves as a reliable tool for airline companies and travel agencies to manage and track customer refunds effectively. Developers can use this endpoint to access detailed information about each refund request, including status and associated flight data. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and financial teams looking to reconcile refund transactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details about flight refunds, including eligibility criteria and refund status. Use this to check the status of your flight refund request or to gather information regarding the refund process.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to initiate a refund process for a flight. Ensure that all required fields are filled in correctly to facilitate a smooth transaction.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for flight refund operations.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsResponse_200.title: Refund Operation Response

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the refund operation.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a refund operation.
